findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following areas of the facility were observed to be in need of repair:

1.) Wall tiles in the back booth area were observed to have gaps at the top where sealing is needed. The person-in-charge (PIC) was instructed to caulk the top of the wall tiles to ensure they are properly sealed and to prevent potential harborage for pests.

2.) Floor tiles beneath the automated drive-through soda machine were observed to be broken, with water accumulation present.

3.) A floor tile beneath the smoothie cooler was observed to be partially broken, with water accumulation present.

The PIC was informed to have all damaged or unsealed floor and wall tiles repaired or sealed prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure floors and walls are maintained in good repair and are smooth, sealed, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT - Dirty mop water and the mop head were observed in the mop bucket next to the mop sink. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed; the dirty water was discarded, and the mop head was placed in the wringer basket. Ensure mop water is discarded immediately after use and mop heads are properly stored by placing them in the wringer basket or hanging them to air-dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed mops being stored in mop buckets in the facility near the mop sink. Discussed proper drying
of mop heads with PIC. PIC had the mops removed from the buckets and placed on the wringer baskets to dry.
Ensure that mops are hung to dry from the wall, the wringer basket of the mop bucket, or another area where
the mops can dry without contaminating the rest of the kitchen.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.15 Cleaning Maintenance Tools, Preventing Contamination. FOOD preparation sinks, HANDWASHING
SINKS, and WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may not be used for the cleaning of maintenance tools , the preparation
or holding of maintenance materials, or the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes.
